apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Metal 4 Rendering is now a saved opt-in toggle, defaulting off, in Settings → Stream and the live Picture panel. Compatible rendering retains independent HDR and MetalFX choices. Direct Metal 4 layer residency, native NVST, HDR/4:4:4, input fixes and normal stats/error reports remain. Frame generation and retired diagnostic extras remain removed. Device Release build and 332 tests pass; shader code is unchanged from the prior 165 GPU checks. Physical build-151 regression pending. Unsigned IPA for installer signing.
